page: Google Cloud Platform c4-highmem-24-lssd is a memory-optimized server instance powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon 6985P-C processor. Operating on the x86_64 architecture, it features 24 virtual CPUs mapped to 12 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. The system is equipped with 186.0 GB of RAM, providing 7.75 GB of memory per core. Local storage is bundled, consisting of four NVMe SSDs totaling 1343 GB of high-speed local capacity.

Benchmark results show top-tier performance in single-threaded operations, with Geekbench single-core scores and single-threaded gzip compression and bzip3 decompression rates reaching the top 10% of tested systems. Multi-core performance is strong, placing in the top 25% for Geekbench multi-core, image processing, and text processing. The processor's support for Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX) and Advanced Vector Extensions (AVX-512) contributes to strong prompt processing and top-tier text generation speeds during LLM inference with smaller models. Memory bandwidth is measured at 2024.01 GB/sec for cached small-block reads and 153.52 GB/sec for uncached large-block reads.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, this instance balances a high-density memory allocation with fast, bundled local NVMe storage, eliminating the need for external block storage for high-throughput local operations. It is well-suited for memory-intensive databases, data compression pipelines, text and image processing applications, and local-storage-dependent workloads that benefit from high single-core performance and dedicated CPU resources.
description: Google Cloud Platform c4-highmem-24-lssd is a memory-optimized server instance featuring 24 vCPUs (12 physical cores) powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon 6985P-C processor at 2.3 GHz. It is equipped with 186.0 GB of RAM and 1343 GB of local NVMe SSD storage across four devices. The x86_64 architecture supports advanced instruction sets including AVX-512 and Intel AMX. Benchmarks indicate top-tier single-core performance, with single-threaded compression and Geekbench single-core scores in the top 10%, alongside strong multi-core and image processing capabilities. The instance delivers high memory bandwidth, reaching 2024.01 GB/sec for cached reads. This hardware profile is highly efficient for memory-intensive databases, text processing, and lightweight machine learning inference workloads requiring fast local storage.
